no_adcom_quote.quote: An advisory committee meeting was not convened for this NDA.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for NDA 211109 (XERAVA/eravacycline). The Multidiscipline Review states plainly that an advisory committee meeting was not convened for this NDA, and the Risk Assessment review notes that at the April 10, 2018 Post Mid-cycle meeting the Agency informed the Applicant that an Advisory Committee meeting was not planned. With no AdComm held, there are no committee-driven linkages to changes in the approval.
